state.review: Adversarial review of the selected definitive business/authority owner boundary. Treat the supplied row as a proposal; do not infer omitted policy.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / artifact-engagement-holds / holdId; place/issuance immutable compares; release expected revision; placement uses newly computed server time. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / artifact-engagement-holds / HoldId, bound to exact artifact, engagement and report issuance. Selected mutations use CommandId.
owners.invariant: One preservation hold cannot release before one year after its exact report issuance; report identity and release decision are immutable.
owners.boundaryRationale: Separating report issuance and release without an immutable issuance proof would allow early release; three irreversible transitions are cohesive.

owners.invariant: One legal hold lifecycle and one exact release after placement.
owners.mustPreserve: Retention is not itself disposal authority; no release by timeout or missing read.

owners.invariant: One supported retention basis for exact content identity.
owners.mustPreserve: Retention is not itself disposal authority; no release by timeout or missing read.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / audit-observations / observationId; program checked inside stream; mutation requires exact nonempty command selector; replay retains only selected command fact and compares intent before revision. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / audit-observations / ObservationId, with immutable ProgramId and examination/source lineage; the exact selected command selector addresses a mutation.
owners.invariant: Received auditor source corrections preserve examination/snapshot and exact source lineage; response/link commands must name current source version, and each selected command identity has immutable intent.
owners.boundaryRationale: A correction racing a response/link would lose the current-source-version gate if moved without source-owner admission authorization. Retaining these current facts is defensible; independent response/link ownership is a close alternative if historical version proofs suffice.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / audit-outcomes / outcomeId; program checked; same normalized content plus canonical recorder no-ops despite later server time; one creation append. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / audit-outcomes / OutcomeId, with immutable ProgramId, delivered package and snapshot provenance. OutcomeId is the selected immutable creation identity.
owners.invariant: One auditor-supplied report conclusion is immutable for its outcome identity and exact delivered package/snapshot provenance.
owners.boundaryRationale: Nothing within the single accepted record can be independently mutated; the report artifact already has its own lifecycle.

owners.invariant: One delivery authorization and terminal delivery for exact recipient/version.
owners.mustPreserve: No current aggregate should retain all build attempts or delivery history as command state.

owners.invariant: Manifest identity, selected immutable content version and delivery gate.
owners.mustPreserve: No current aggregate should retain all build attempts or delivery history as command state.

logicalIdentity.rule: UUIDv5(source eventId, length-prefixed effectKind + canonical target stream + source lifecycle episode); external process callback source is the immutable accepted business source event plus exact effect key, never attemptId.

Must equal existing UUIDv5(53cb20d6-01ef-5fd5-99b3-04087e39bf77, packageId + newline + packageVersion + newline + Clean(recipient) + newline + Clean(deliveryReference)); this identifies exact manual delivery recording.

Required BuildKey with PackageId/PackageVersion. IIdentifiedRequest.RequestId = UUIDv5(698c0bb6-2dfc-58b3-b2fd-2f3dc04369f8, $"{PackageId}\n{PackageVersion}\n{BuildKey.Trim()}"); preserve existing token validation.

owners.declaredIdentity: Tenant / audit-populations / populationId (Define handler uses DefinitionId); definition/source/row/export identities checked; one shared expectedRevision; several mutators check revision before retry. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant / audit-populations / PopulationId. Selected definition creation is identified by DefinitionId; later selected commands use their exact CommandId or GenerationKey and population/source scope from the signature.
owners.invariant: One population owns complete current definition/source/row classification, reconciliation invalidation, completeness proof and freeze seal. Immutable row/version bodies are values outside retained command state; no independent AuditPopulationRowDecision root or projected-count freeze authority.
owners.boundaryRationale: Keep current complete row/category/source reconciliation and authoritative freeze seal together. Immutable row/version content may use chunked capsules and history projections; independent export attempts need their own process/identity. No per-row projected counts may decide freeze.
